interpretation.task_aligned_metrics: Persona+History is stronger on HarmBench, PCSA target compliance/UNSAFE, B4+, and strict joint.

interpretation.replication_scope: The implementation reconstructs the published Phase-II design with Qwen attacker/target, N=4, and at most four target turns; it is not an exact model-level replication of the paper.
